answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance comes from making identity expensive and verifiable. Each agent stakes collateral into a shared vault, and its voting weight is capped by proven work history rather than by how many wallets it controls. A falcon-class scout watches for clusters of fresh identities sharing one funding source; when that pattern appears, it raises the entry bond like timber barricading a road. Honest agents must also clear a periodic beacon challenge derived from the epoch seed, answering with original prose that cheap mass clones can never attest.
